meta.title: Pulling part of a PR line reserves exactly that part
gaps: The setup recipe cannot create a QA PR line or enable the allow_draft_project_creation gate.
The required request needs a PR line identifier and body fields not available as tokens or supported operation fields.

Reading the PR in the Open and In-progress tabs, including draft_projects_quantity_data, in-progress quantity, open quantity, and status, is not supported by the available operations or read-back fields.
